meanings.meaning: 从...卸下货物（指从交通工具上卸下货物，与load（装载）相对）

meanings.usage: 由名词wood + en构成，表示材质
用于强调程度，相当于very much，但语气更强
常用于It occurred to sb that...句型，表示某人突然想起
指发现原本存在但未被知晓的事物或情况
常与to连用，表示被困在狭小空间
后接名词或动名词，表示承认某事
指依法拘留犯罪嫌疑人

meanings.meaning: 说明（原因）（account for表示解释原因或占据（数量比例））

meanings.usage: a pile of表示一堆，可用于实物或抽象概念
be ordered to do sth表示被命令做某事
指商品或服务的价格，常与high/low搭配
指短途旅行或行程，也可指旅途

phrases.usage: 开始做某事，表示动作的开始

examples.en: Workers began to unload the boxes.

phrases.usage: 许多；若干，后接可数名词复数

examples.en: A number of wooden boxes contained clothing.

phrases.phrase: It occurred to sb to do sth

examples.en: It occurred to one of the workers to open up the box.
examples.zh: 其中一个工人突然想起要打开箱子。

examples.en: He was astonished at what he found.
examples.zh: 他对发现的东西感到非常惊讶。

phrases.usage: 试图/企图做某事（但未必成功）

examples.en: He did not even try to run away.
The boy ran away from home.
examples.zh: 那个男孩从家里逃跑了。

examples.en: The man was ordered to pay £3,500.
examples.zh: 那个男子被要求支付3500英镑。

examples.en: He was ordered to pay for the cost of the trip.
examples.zh: 他被要求支付旅途费用。

examples.en: A man was lying on top of a pile of woollen goods.
examples.zh: 一名男子躺在羊毛制品堆的上面。

examples.en: He hid in the box before the plane left London.
examples.zh: 他在飞机离开伦敦之前藏进了箱子里。

grammar.title: 过去进行时 (Past Continuous Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时刻或某一段时间正在进行的动作 描述故事发生的背景或正在进行的动作，常与when/while连用

examples.en: Workers were unloading wooden boxes when they found the heavy box.
examples.zh: 工人们正在卸木箱时，发现了那个很重的箱子。

examples.en: The man was hiding in the box when the plane arrived.
examples.zh: 飞机到达时，那个男子正藏在箱子里。

grammar.title: 过去完成时 (Past Perfect Tense)
grammar.structure: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时间之前已经完成的动作，即"过去的过去" 用于过去完成时的动作发生在另一个过去动作之前，常与before/after连用

examples.en: The man admitted hiding in the box before the plane left London.
examples.zh: 那个人承认在飞机离开伦敦之前就藏进了箱子里。

examples.en: He had been confined to the box for over eighteen hours.
examples.zh: 他已经被关在箱子里超过十八个小时了。

grammar.title: 过去完成进行时 (Past Perfect Continuous Tense)
grammar.structure: 主语 + had been + 动词-ing
grammar.definition: 表示过去某一时间之前一直在进行的动作 强调动作的持续性和持续时间

examples.en: He had been waiting for over eighteen hours.
examples.zh: 他已经等了超过十八个小时。

examples.en: The plane had been flying for ten hours before it arrived.
examples.zh: 飞机到达前已经飞了十个小时。

patterns.pattern: No one could account for the fact that...

original.en: No one could account for the fact that one of the boxes was extremely heavy.
original.zh: 没有人能解释其中一个箱子特别重这一事实。

imitations.en: No one could account for the fact that he was late.
imitations.zh: 没有人能解释他迟到的原因。

imitations.en: No one could account for the fact that the door was open.
imitations.zh: 没有人能解释门为什么开着。

patterns.pattern: It occurred to sb to do sth

original.en: It suddenly occurred to one of the workers to open up the box.
original.zh: 其中一个工人突然想起要打开箱子。

imitations.en: It occurred to me to call my mother.
imitations.zh: 我突然想起要给我妈妈打电话。

imitations.en: It occurred to him to ask for help.
imitations.zh: 他突然想起要请求帮助。

original.en: The man was ordered to pay £3,500 for the cost of the trip.
original.zh: 那名男子被要求支付3500英镑的旅途费用。

imitations.en: He was ordered to leave the room.
The students were ordered to finish the test in one hour.
imitations.zh: 学生们被要求在一小时内完成考试。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + had been + 动词-ing + for/over + 时间段

original.en: He had been confined to the wooden box for over eighteen hours.
original.zh: 他已经被关在木箱里超过十八个小时了。

imitations.en: She had been waiting for over two hours.
imitations.zh: 她已经等了两个多小时。

imitations.en: They had been working for over ten hours.
imitations.zh: 他们已经工作了十多个小时。

lines.en: When a plane from London arrived at Sydney airport, workers began to unload a number of wooden boxes which contained clothing.
lines.zh: 当一架来自伦敦的飞机抵达悉尼机场时，工人们开始卸下装有服装的一批木箱。

lines.en: No one could account for the fact that one of the boxes was extremely heavy.
lines.zh: 其中有只箱子特别重，可谁也弄不清是怎么回事。

lines.en: It suddenly occurred to one of the workers to open up the box.
lines.zh: 突然一个工人想到打开箱子看看。

lines.en: He was astonished at what he found. A man was lying in the box on top of a pile of woolen goods.
lines.zh: 看到的情景使人吃惊，箱内有一个人正躺在一堆毛织品之上。

lines.en: He was so surprised at being discovered that he did not even try to run away.
lines.zh: 他由于被人发现而感到非常吃惊，甚至都没有企图逃跑。

lines.en: After he was arrested, the man admitted hiding in the box before the plane left London.
lines.zh: 此人被逮捕后，承认他是在飞机离开伦敦前躲进箱里的。

lines.en: He had had a long and uncomfortable trip, for he had been confined to the wooden box for over eighteen hours.
lines.zh: 他经历了一次漫长而又难受的旅程，因为他在那木箱里闷了18个多小时。

lines.en: The man was ordered to pay $3,500 for the cost of the trip. The normal price of a ticket is $2,000!
lines.zh: 此人被责令交付旅费3,500英镑，而正常票价是2,000英镑！

questions.q: What did the man in this story do?
questions.zh: 这个故事里的那个男子做了什么事？
questions.a: He hid in a wooden box before the plane left London, hoping to fly to Sydney without buying a ticket; after he was discovered and arrested, he was ordered to pay £3,500 for the cost of the trip.
questions.aZh: 他在飞机离开伦敦之前就躲进一只木箱，想不买票偷乘到悉尼；被发现逮捕后，被责令支付 3,500 英镑的旅费。

questions.q: Why did one of the wooden boxes draw the workers' attention?
questions.zh: 为什么其中一只木箱引起了工人们的注意？
questions.a: Because one of the boxes was extremely heavy and no one could account for it.
questions.aZh: 因为有只箱子特别沉，谁也说不清是怎么回事。
questions.hint: 见第 2 句，account for 意为“解释、说明”。

questions.q: What did the worker find when he opened up the box?
questions.zh: 工人打开箱子后发现了什么？
questions.a: He found a man lying in the box on top of a pile of woollen goods.
questions.aZh: 他发现箱里躺着一个人，那人躺在一堆毛织品上面。

questions.q: How long had the man stayed in the box and how much was he ordered to pay?
questions.zh: 那人在箱子里待了多久？被责令付多少钱？
questions.a: He had been confined to the wooden box for over eighteen hours, and he was ordered to pay £3,500, while the normal price of a ticket is £2,000.
questions.aZh: 他在木箱里被关了十八个多小时，被责令支付 3,500 英镑，而正常票价只有 2,000 英镑。

questions.q: What does the title 'Expensive and uncomfortable' really mean?
questions.zh: 标题“既昂贵又难受”究竟指什么？
questions.a: It refers to both his fare and his suffering: he paid £3,500 instead of the normal £2,000 and had been confined to a wooden box for over eighteen hours. It was far from worth it.
questions.aZh: expensive 指他被罚的旅费比票价还贵；uncomfortable 指他在木箱里闷了十八个多小时的难受旅程。偷乘一点都不划算。
questions.hint: 把第 7、8 两句的数字与时间对比。

translation:
当一架来自伦敦的飞机抵达悉尼机场时，工人们开始卸下装有服装的一批木箱。
其中有只箱子特别重，可谁也弄不清是怎么回事。
突然一个工人想到打开箱子看看。
看到的情景使人吃惊，箱内有一个人正躺在一堆毛织品之上。
他由于被人发现而感到非常吃惊，甚至都没有企图逃跑。
此人被逮捕后，承认他是在飞机离开伦敦前躲进箱里的。
他经历了一次漫长而又难受的旅程，因为他在那木箱里闷了18个多小时。
此人被责令交付旅费3,500英镑，而正常票价是2,000英镑！
title: Expensive and uncomfortable
subtitle: 既昂贵又难受

lead.question: 一只飞抵悉尼的木箱为何特别沉？里面躺着谁，他又付出了什么代价？
lead.warmup: 从伦敦飞往悉尼要飞十几个小时，票价自然不便宜。有个人为了省下这笔钱，在飞机起飞前钻进一只装服装的木箱，指望一路“免费”抵达。可他不仅要挤在木箱里颠簸十八个多小时，最后还被责令支付远高于票价的旅费。究竟是谁发现了他？
goals: 熟练运用 account for、a pile of、on top of、it occurred to sb that、be astonished at、admit doing、be confined to
归纳与 to、at、for、with 连用的动词（occur to、confine to、account for、astonished at 等）
用过去时与过去完成时按时间顺序复述偷乘经过
lead.summary: 本课讲一个偷乘飞机的男子。飞机从伦敦飞抵悉尼后，工人们卸下几只装服装的木箱，其中一只重得离奇。一名工人忽然想到打开箱子，眼前的景象令他大吃一惊：箱里躺着一个人，身下是一堆毛织品。那人被捕后承认是在飞机起飞前躲进箱里的，最终被责令支付 3,500 英镑旅费，而正常机票只要 2,000 英镑。
lead.tips: occur 表示“某人想起某事”时主语是事不是人，应说 It occurred to him to open the box；admit 后接 doing 表示“承认做过”。

exercises.q: 词形与构词：workers began ________ (卸) a number of ________ (wood) boxes which contained clothing.
短语填空：No one could ________ ________ the fact that one of the boxes was ________ (extreme) heavy.
汉译英：一个工人突然想到打开箱子看看。（用 it occurred to sb to do）
exercises.a: It suddenly occurred to one of the workers to open up the box.

exercises.q: 汉译英：他对自己的发现感到吃惊。（用 be astonished at）
exercises.a: He was astonished at what he found.

exercises.q: 补全短语：A man was lying in the box on top of ________ ________ ________ woollen ________ (一堆毛织品).
动词形式：the man admitted ________ (hide) in the box before the plane left London.
介词搭配：It occurred ________ him；be confined ________ a box；pay £3,500 ________ the trip；quarrel ________ his brother。
exercises.note: 与 to 连用：occur to、confine to。

quiz.q: 飞机抵达悉尼机场后，工人们开始做什么？
options: They began to unload a number of wooden boxes.
They began to load the plane with clothing.
They began to open up every box at once.
They began to look for the missing passenger.

quiz.q: 谁也无法解释的事实是什么？
options: One of the boxes was extremely heavy.
The plane arrived at Sydney very late.
All the boxes contained woollen goods.
The clothing was made of wool.

quiz.q: 打开箱子后，工人看到了什么？
options: A man was lying in the box on top of a pile of woollen goods.
A man was standing in the box and shouting for help.
A pile of woollen goods was lying on top of a man.
A big dog was sleeping among the clothes.

quiz.q: 那人被发现后为什么没有逃跑？
options: He was so surprised at being discovered that he did not even try to run away.
He was too tired after the long trip to move.
He was confined to the box and could not get out.
He wanted to pay for the cost of the trip at once.
quiz.note: so surprised at being discovered that...

quiz.q: 他最终为自己的旅程付出了什么代价？
options: He was ordered to pay £3,500 for the cost of the trip.
He was ordered to pay £2,000, the normal price of a ticket.
He was ordered to pay £1,500 for the wooden box.
He was ordered to unload all the boxes himself.

quiz.q: 下列哪一句正确表达“我从未想到他会是个小偷”？
options: It never occurred to me that he could be a thief.
I never occurred that he could be a thief.
He never occurred to be a thief to me.
It never occurred to him that I could be a thief.
